models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B
models.why: A 125B-class MoE that serves 64 concurrent users from one vLLM instance at over 100 tok/s each, and still decodes ~21 tok/s on a single 24GB RTX 4090 with hybrid expert offload.

engines.quant: NVFP4 weights, vLLM, a single instance serving 64 concurrent users from one request each; 134.4 tok/s per user with no extra acceleration techniques (same instance: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B NVFP4 at 142.2 tok/s per user)
